Name: Herod Agrippa I
Summary: Herod Agrippa I, grandson of Herod the Great, ruled Judea in the 40s AD. He killed the apostle James with the sword, imprisoned Peter, and died suddenly after accepting the crowd's cry that his voice was a god's.
KeyStory: Agrippa struck at the church and was himself struck down, eaten by worms, for not giving God glory.
RelatedPeople: James, Son of Zebedee; Simon Peter; Barnabas
LifeLesson: Persecutors rise and fall on God's timetable. Agrippa's crown could not outlast a single sermon of pride.
